title: 🌊 The Drowned City of Damvauthier | French Story Listening
description:
Coucou les French Story Listeners! 🌿

Tonight is the night after la Toussaint. Legend says that if you stand by the lac de Saint-Point tonight, you can hear bells ringing from deep under the water… 🔔

Today we travel to Franche-Comté, in the east of France, for a very old legend: Le lac de Saint-Point.

Long ago, at the edge of a deep forest of fir trees (une forêt de sapins), there was a city called Damvauthier. Une ville très, très riche. Houses decorated with gold, pearls and rubies, and feasts every night…

One snowy winter night, a poor woman arrives. She is barefoot and holds her freezing baby in a blanket (une couverture). She knocks on every door. « Partez, partez ! »

And at midnight… ding, dong. 🌊

What happened to Damvauthier? And why do the bells still ring under the lake? Come and listen.

🌱 How to watch

You don’t need to understand every word. Really. 

Make a cup of tea or coffee, get comfortable, and let the drawings, gestures and the story carry you.

This is Story Listening, a method developed by Dr. Beniko Mason. You hear a compelling story in simple French, with pictures and words on the board, and your mind does the rest. No drills, no memorizing, no pressure.

Charlotte Mason reminds us that the mind feeds on ideas. A living idea, planted gently in a living mind, grows on its own. That’s exactly what we do here.
